row.title: An executor PR that only undoes main's last day is refused
row.body: CHURN-GUARD-1 (ZHC-R13 #2678): checks runs churn --gate --executor; a change whose every file returns to a pre-commit state of the last 24 h fails. redmain repairs and non-executor PRs are not gated.
